---
title: "Blood Pressure"
format:
  html:
    css: styles.css
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTFoq1LYMZBV8vbNbIa53B6O0DGwI3OjtvsgQER_kOgW4zyPhSkz3-EXi5mCclb8SNr9XPnGjV9c8O4/pub?gid=1315116594&single=true&output=csv"

data <- read.csv(
  sheet_url,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

data$Timestamp <- as.POSIXct(
  data$Timestamp,
  format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S"
)

data$Date <- as.Date(data$Timestamp)

latest_date <- max(data$Date, na.rm = TRUE)

start_date <- latest_date - 6

last_7_days <- data[
  data$Date >= start_date &
  data$Date <= latest_date,
]

systolic_average <- mean(
  as.numeric(last_7_days[["Systolic BP"]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

diastolic_average <- mean(
  as.numeric(last_7_days[["Diastolic BP"]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pulse_average <- mean(
  as.numeric(last_7_days[["Pulse"]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

lowest_systolic <- min(
  as.numeric(last_7_days[["Systolic BP"]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

highest_systolic <- max(
  as.numeric(last_7_days[["Systolic BP"]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

systolic_class <- if (systolic_average < 125) "good" else ""
diastolic_class <- if (diastolic_average < 80) "good" else ""
pulse_class <- if (pulse_average < 80) "good" else ""

cat(
  '<h2>7-Day Average</h2>',

  '<div class="bp-container">',

  '<div class="bp-card ', systolic_class, '">',
  '<h3 class="no-link">Systolic</h3>',
  '<span class="bp-number">',
  sprintf("%.1f", systolic_average),
  '</span>',
  '<p>mmHg</p>',
  '</div>',

  '<div class="bp-card ', diastolic_class, '">',
  '<h3 class="no-link">Diastolic</h3>',
  '<span class="bp-number">',
  sprintf("%.1f", diastolic_average),
  '</span>',
  '<p>mmHg</p>',
  '</div>',

  '<div class="bp-card ', pulse_class, '">',
  '<h3 class="no-link">Pulse</h3>',
  '<span class="bp-number">',
  sprintf("%.1f", pulse_average),
  '</span>',
  '<p>bpm</p>',
  '</div>',

  '</div>',

  '<h2>Systolic Range</h2>',

  '<div class="bp-container">',

  '<div class="bp-card">',
  '<h3>Lowest</h3>',
  '<span class="bp-number">',
  sprintf("%.0f", lowest_systolic),
  '</span>',
  '<p>mmHg</p>',
  '</div>',

  '<div class="bp-card">',
  '<h3>Highest</h3>',
  '<span class="bp-number">',
  sprintf("%.0f", highest_systolic),
  '</span>',
  '<p>mmHg</p>',
  '</div>',

  '</div>'
)
```
